response.sql: WITH linked_data AS (SELECT ab.translink, t.tradekind FROM advancedbehavior ab INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg), combo_counts AS (SELECT translink, tradekind, COUNT(*) as combo_count FROM linked_data GROUP BY translink, tradekind), type_totals AS (SELECT tradekind, SUM(combo_count) as type_total FROM combo_counts GROUP BY tradekind), shares_and_avg AS (SELECT cc.translink, cc.tradekind, cc.combo_count, CAST(cc.combo_count AS FLOAT) / tt.type_total as combo_share, AVG(CAST(cc.combo_count AS FLOAT) / tt.type_total) OVER (PARTITION BY cc.tradekind) as type_avg_share FROM combo_counts cc JOIN type_totals tt ON cc.tradekind = tt.tradekind), above_avg AS (SELECT translink, tradekind, combo_count, combo_share, type_avg_share FROM shares_and_avg WHERE combo_share > type_avg_share) SELECT tradekind, AVG(combo_count) as avg_count, AVG(combo_share) as avg_share, AVG(combo_share) - MAX(type_avg_share) as avg_margin FROM above_avg GROUP BY tradekind ORDER BY tradekind
